messages.subject: Siam City Cement | Industrial decarbonization, ESG and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Siam City Cement Leadership Team,

Cement sits among the sectors where sustainability depends on disciplined operating change, energy choices and stakeholder trust. That makes Siam City Cement a strong fit for my background.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My role covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate coordination and executive stakeholder strategy across a large industrial operation.

My recent work includes stakeholder and governance support around a major solar and battery-storage transition, carbon-data readiness based on physical records, environmental regulator engagement and community-sensitive execution. I am used to working across technical and corporate teams where decarbonization goals must align with operating continuity and public expectations.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional responsibilities in Sustainability, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or stakeholder leadership. I have attached a Siam City Cement-focused executive CV for review.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
